resources.string: NanoKVM needs local network access to connect directly to %1$s. It does not scan your network or send this access to another service.
NanoKVM cannot reach %1$s until local network access is allowed. You can try the Android permission request again.
NanoKVM cannot reach %1$s until local network access is enabled in Android settings.
NanoKVM needs local network access for the one-time AP onboarding endpoint. It does not scan or auto-discover networks.
AP onboarding cannot reach the user-supplied endpoint until local network access is enabled.
NanoKVM can review one direct plain-text share. Rich text, files, links supplied through content providers, and empty shares are not opened.
Choose a NanoKVM connection to review the shared text. Nothing will be sent automatically.
